name: I Like You
source:
The dream girl of every guy, Yuri Vandall, became your girlfriend after she confessed to you. She invites you to her house for a study session, but it seems she has another motive...

Escape, survive, and find the truth behind her facade in this short horror-suspense visual novel.

A game created for Spooktober Visual Novel Jam 2022.

[From [url=https://izumi-games.itch.io/i-like-you]Itch.io[/url]]
